with_u.fold_protocol: caller-supplied repeated outer folds; authority recorded in provenance
with_u.mask_protocol: caller-supplied training-only label masks; authority recorded in provenance

metric_policy.auc: ROC AUC of the explicit positive class's held-out probability; null if either true class is absent
metric_policy.gmean: sqrt(positive recall * negative recall); null if either true class is absent
metric_policy.iam: mean((diagonal - max(off-diagonal row, off-diagonal column))/max(row total, column total))
metric_policy.iam_absent_class: undefined (null) if a class has zero row and column totals
metric_policy.orientation: true rows, predicted columns; label order negative, positive
metric_policy.probability_auc: explicit alias of probability ROC AUC; not SSHR printed AUC

preprocessing_policy.categorical_encoding: training one-hot categories; unknown test categories become all-zero
preprocessing_policy.fidelity: declared engineering conventions; exact author ordering/encoding/scaling unknown
preprocessing_policy.fit_pool: observed L only; original numeric features only
preprocessing_policy.numeric_missing: training median; all-missing training columns filled with 0
preprocessing_policy.scaling: training StandardScaler after filtering, including encoded columns
preprocessing_policy.variance_filter: after imputation/encoding, drop a feature constant within either training class

archive.verification: local archive SHA-256 and extracted raw-member SHA-256 verified

provenance.coordinate_group_policy: Preserve every raw row. Group identical raw feature-coordinate vectors before outer splitting and label hiding; reject groups containing conflicting gold labels at experimental-design time.
provenance.dataset_selection_policy: Selected before any held-out score: numerical declarations, existing locally verified files, no missing or nonfinite values, sufficient minority rows for five outer folds and training-only label hiding.
provenance.feature_metadata_authority: Original KEEL input attribute declarations; all declared real
provenance.fold_source: Five stratified-group outer folds repeated five times; identical original raw feature vectors stay together; NumPy SeedSequence([42,repeat,0,1]); author folds unavailable; no redraw
provenance.hidden_label_policy: Gold labels are used only for experimental-design stratification/conflict checking and evaluator-side retrospective audit; hidden labels never enter learned methods.
provenance.kind: hash-verified local numeric KEEL binary variant; descriptive controlled pilot
provenance.mask_source: Hide training labels only: class-wise permutation of whole coordinate groups with NumPy SeedSequence([42,repeat,fold,2]); retain group prefixes until max(2,floor(.5*class_training_rows)); preserve original training row order; no redraw; not a verified author protocol
provenance.source_fidelity: User-provided local archives and extracted files; author rows, folds, preprocessing and unlabelled-pool construction unverified.

ablation.policy: Canonical comparison uses the intersection of successful finite-score repeat/fold events across every selected method separately per classifier. All-method-success summaries are supplementary. Repeated fold scores are dependent; sample SD is descriptive, not an inferential standard error. Counts describe fold events, not unique individuals; classifiers are not pooled.

diagnostics.coordinate_duplicate_scope: successful fold events per classifier; missing diagnostic fields are not assumed zero
diagnostics.counts_scope: successful fold events; repeated rows and separate classifiers are not unique observations
diagnostics.failed_job_removal_scope: saved unsuccessful jobs with available counts; absent counts are unknown
diagnostics.overlap_policy: strict nearest observed majority vs minority, original reduced L only; ties separate; not true overlap
